name: xyz.tereno/tereno
title: Tereno on Base
description: Check a Base contract, an unsigned transaction or a public web page before you act on it. Returns a verdict with the evidence behind it, the limits of that evidence and the block it stops being valid at. Catalog, pricing and receipt lookups are free; answers are paid per call with x402 in USDC from $0.001, and reusing an answer another agent already paid for costs less.
